Sammy, a fifth grader with curly brown hair, always wondered what would happen if she knocked on the door of that spooky old house. One stormy night, Sammy and her younger brother walked over to the spooky house and crept up to the front porch. The dusty
wood floor creaked under their feet.

Sammy raised her shaky arm and knocked on the door. All of a sudden, the siblings heard a loud noise. They were too scared to wait to find out what it was. They made a speedy exit across the muddy yard and ran all the way home.
